messages.subject: DATA TRANSFORM
messages.body_plain:
Hi there

I am a newbie to R and to Deducer, but what a great product so far as
I am useless with getting R to do anything useful as a non coder.

The one issue I had when uploading my data is transforming prices to a
%, although I could trandform it to (log+1) I am more interested in
the log difference, is there a way to do this in Deducer or must I do
it via R code.

Thanks

Mike

messages.subject: Re: DATA TRANSFORM
messages.body_plain:
Mike,

I have not figured out any GUI way to make variable computations
simpler than just entering the code into the console. Do something
like:

data$newVar <- log(data$var1 - data$var$2)

Best,
Ian

messages.subject_clean: When loading Deducer: "Error: package 'iplots' could not be loaded"
messages.body_plain:
Now I've encountered a problem with JGR.  When I attempt to load JGR,
this is the error message I get:

> library(JGR)

Loading required package: iplots
Note: On Mac OS X we strongly recommend using iplots from within JGR.
Proceed at your own risk as iplots cannot resolve potential ev.loop
deadlocks.
'Yes' is assumed for all dialogs as they cannot be shown without a
deadlock,
also ievent.wait() is disabled.
Error in .jnew("org/rosuda/iplots/Framework") :
  java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError
Error: package 'iplots' could not be loaded

It doesn't make sense.  The message warns me to load iplots from
within JGR but then tells me that JGR can't open because iplots can't
be loaded.  If I can just solve this then I think I'll finally be able
to use Deducer.
